ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: module receives global clock (driven by external clock)
ports.evidence: used in sensitivity lists and rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: module receives async active-low reset (driven by external reset)
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... reset assignments to internal signals

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.function: module receives bus request record (incoming bus transactions)

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: module receives bus address (used to select register or FIFO)

relationship.object: control register vs FIFO data region

ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then -- control register else data

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.function: module receives bus write data (drives control and tx FIFO)
ports.evidence: used to update ctrl fields and tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(...)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.function: unclear from RTL (byte-enable field not used)
ports.evidence: no references to bus_req_i.ben in RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.function: module receives bus strobe (request valid indicator)

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.function: module receives bus read/write indicator (driven by bus master)
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then -- write access else -- read access

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.function: unclear from RTL (source field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.function: unclear from RTL (privilege field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.function: unclear from RTL (debug field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.function: unclear from RTL (AMO field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.function: unclear from RTL (AMO opcode field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.function: unclear from RTL (lock field not used)

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.function: unclear from RTL (fence field not used)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.function: module drives bus response record (sends ack/data/err)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.function: module drives response acknowledge (acknowledge bus request)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.function: module drives response error flag (always cleared)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.function: module drives response data (readback of registers or RX FIFO)
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= ctrl fields or bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.function: module drives clock-generator enable (driven from ctrl.enable)

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.function: module receives prescaled clock taps (clock-generator inputs)

ports.name: spi_clk_o
ports.function: module drives SPI serial clock (SCK output)

ports.name: spi_dat_o
ports.function: module drives SPI data out (controller MOSI output)

ports.name: spi_dat_i
ports.function: module receives SPI data in (sampled from peripheral MISO)

ports.name: spi_csn_o
ports.function: module drives SPI chip-selects (active-low CS outputs)

ports.name: irq_o
ports.function: module drives interrupt request output (transmission/FIFO events)
ports.evidence: irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail) or ... )

signals.name: ctrl
signals.function: SPI control register bundle holding configuration bits
signals.evidence: ctrl fields assigned in bus_access process on writes from bus_req_i.data

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.function: Master enable for SPI controller and FIFOs
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access process

signals.name: ctrl.cpha
signals.function: Clock phase selection for SPI transfers
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpha <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpha_c) in bus_access process

signals.name: ctrl.cpol
signals.function: Clock polarity selection for SPI transfers
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpol <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpol_c) in bus_access process

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.function: Prescaler select for pre-scaling clock input
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.function: Fine clock divider for SPI clock generation
signals.evidence: ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.highspeed
signals.function: High-speed mode flag for clock generation bypass
signals.evidence: ctrl.highspeed <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_highspeed_c) in bus_access process

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_avail
signals.function: Enable IRQ when RX FIFO has data available
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_avail <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_avail_c) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.function: Enable IRQ when TX FIFO is empty
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.function: Enable IRQ when TX FIFO is below half-full
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.irq_idle
signals.function: Enable IRQ when engine idle and TX FIFO empty
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_idle <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_idle_c) in bus_access

signals.name: cdiv_cnt
signals.function: Fine-divider counter for SPI clock generation
signals.evidence: cdiv_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cdiv_cnt) + 1) in clock_generator

signals.name: spi_clk_en
signals.function: One-cycle enable pulse for SPI clock toggles
signals.evidence: spi_clk_en set '1' when cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv in clock_generator

signals.name: rtx_engine
signals.function: SPI transmit/receive engine state bundle
signals.evidence: rtx_engine fields assigned in transceiver clocked process (state machine)

signals.name: rtx_engine.state
signals.function: State vector for SPI engine FSM
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.state bits assigned and used in transceiver process case statement

signals.name: rtx_engine.busy
signals.function: Indicates engine busy when state not idle
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.busy <= '0' when (rtx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1' (concurrent)

signals.name: rtx_engine.sreg
signals.function: 8-bit shift register for serial data output
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sreg <= rtx_engine.sreg(6 downto 0) & rtx_engine.sdi_sync in transceiver

signals.name: rtx_engine.bitcnt
signals.function: Counts transferred bits during a byte transfer
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.bitcnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(rtx_engine.bitcnt) + 1) in transceiver

signals.name: rtx_engine.sdi_sync
signals.function: Synchronized sampled serial data input
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i when spi_clk_en in transceiver

signals.name: rtx_engine.sck
signals.function: Internal SPI clock signal driven by engine
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sck assigned in transceiver; drives spi_clk_o concurrently

signals.name: rtx_engine.cs_ctrl
signals.function: Chip-select control vector for selecting peripheral
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) on command; default cleared on reset

signals.name: rtx_engine.done
signals.function: Flag indicating completion of byte transmission
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.done <= '1' set in transceiver when last bit transferred

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.function: Transmit FIFO interface bundle to FIFO component
signals.evidence: tx_fifo fields connected to neorv32_fifo port map (wdata_i,we_i,re_i,avail_o,free_o)

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.function: Write-enable input into TX FIFO
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='1' and addr(2)='1' else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.function: Read-enable input for TX FIFO consumption
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100") else '0' (concurrent)

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.function: Write data bus into TX FIFO (cmd/data + byte)
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.function: Read data output from TX FIFO (command/data word)
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.rdata examined in transceiver: if (tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1') then ...

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.function: Indicates TX FIFO contains data to send
signals.evidence: if (tx_fifo.avail = '1') then -- trigger new transmission (transceiver); used in bus_access

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.function: Indicates TX FIFO has at least one free entry
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) <= not tx_fifo.free in bus_access read

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.function: Synchronous clear control for TX FIFO (active high)
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent)

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.function: Indicates TX FIFO is at least half-full
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.half connected from FIFO half_o; used in irq and status reads (not tx_fifo.half)

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.function: Receive FIFO interface bundle to FIFO component
signals.evidence: rx_fifo fields connected to neorv32_fifo port map (wdata_i,we_i,re_i,rdata_o,avail_o)

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.function: Write-enable input into RX FIFO (from engine)
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done (concurrent)

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.function: Read-enable input for RX FIFO from bus reads
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='0' and addr(2)='1' else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.function: Write data bus into RX FIFO (dummy bit + byte)
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg (concurrent) to append dummy fill-bit

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.function: Read data output from RX FIFO (received byte)
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) in bus_access read branch

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.function: Indicates RX FIFO has data available to read
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_avail_c) <= rx_fifo.avail and used in irq_generator conditions

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.function: Indicates RX FIFO has free entries available
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.free connected from FIFO free_o in port map

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.function: Synchronous clear control for RX FIFO (active high)
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent)

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.function: Indicates RX FIFO is at least half-full
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.half connected from FIFO half_o in port map
